title: Ariana Grande Reclaims the London Stage After 7 Years: 5 Best Moments
summary: The pop star made a spectacular return to the capital for the first of 10 nights at The O2 (Aug. 15).
body: ‘Violent Fairy Pop Core’ reads the block-capitals slogan emblazoned across Ariana Grande ’s new, hardcore-inspired merch line . It appears to be the singer’s personal embodiment of the sound and aesthetic of her latest LP, Petal , which arrived last month (July 29) and feels like a distillation of the music itself: equally ethereal and defiant, with guitar-driven, lightly abrasive sounds propelling themes of femininity, freedom and contending with life in the public eye. In the fortnight since it dropped, Petal has topped both the Official U.K. Albums Chart and the Billboard 200 , with Grande scoring her best single-week performance of the 2020s thus far on the latter. All 12 songs from the album landed in the Billboard Hot 100’s top 40 , while the newly-released video for its title track has also sparked intense online discourse about the singer’s physical appearance. The conversation has, at times, threatened to eclipse the contents of a project that is already preoccupied with the pressures of visibility. Suffice to say, then, that Grande arrives in London at a charged moment. It makes for an intriguing juncture in the wider Petal campaign, which has had a notably darker, disil…
